label: Frankfurter (exchange rates)
terms_note: Open-source (MIT) API for current and historical reference exchange rates blended from central banks and public providers; no key, no documented quota.

config_fields.name: base_currency
config_fields.help: ISO 4217 base currency for get_series (the API's `base`, default EUR per the spec).

search_symbols.note: Searches the currency list (GET /currencies: every active currency with its name, e.g. 'dollar', 'yen' or 'USD'); the API has no search parameter, so the server filters code and name locally (case-insensitive substring) and pages the matches. `raw` has iso_numeric, the local symbol and start_date/end_date.

get_series.note: series_id is the quote currency (ISO 4217, e.g. USD); values are units of it per 1 base currency (config base_currency, default EUR). start/end are YYYY-MM-DD; without them the API returns the latest rate only. One record per date (daily).

not_offered.me: No accounts or keys: the API is public ('no API key required', https://frankfurter.dev/).
not_offered.get_candles: Reference rates only: one blended rate per currency per date, no OHLC candles (GET /rates returns {date, base, quote, rate}).
not_offered.get_news: The API serves exchange rates only; there is no news endpoint in the spec.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
